mapper.select: SELECT id, config_type, ai_provider, ai_base_url, ai_api_key, ai_model, enabled, note, gmt_create, gmt_modified FROM ai_model_config ORDER BY FIELD(config_type, 'TEXT', 'IMAGE', 'VIDEO', 'IMAGE_EDIT')
SELECT id, config_type, ai_provider, ai_base_url, ai_api_key, ai_model, enabled, note, gmt_create, gmt_modified FROM ai_model_config WHERE config_type = #{configType} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_model_config SET ai_provider = #{aiProvider}, ai_base_url = #{aiBaseUrl}, ai_api_key = #{aiApiKey}, ai_model = #{aiModel}, enabled = #{enabled}, note = #{note}, gmt_modified = NOW() WHERE config_type = #{configType}
